 "rationale": "A full 1.2 V bandgap does not fit in 1.8 V with |Vtp| near 1 V, so this design sums currents instead. I = Veb/R3 + UT*ln8/R1 is set flat in temperature through R3/R1, and Vref = I*R4 gives 0.95 V. Three branches of about 0.43 uA each plus start-up leakage come to about 2.4 uW. L=6 PMOS mirrors bound line regulation near 30 mV/V. Large PNP m lowers Veb, which keeps Vds headroom for MN2. An inverter on vref pulls the mirror gate low at start-up."}

PARAMS = {
    "R1":    (250e3, 120e3, 600e3),   # PTAT resistor (sets PTAT part of branch current)
    "k3":    (11.0, 7.0, 16.0),       # R3/R1 ratio -> TC trim
    "vref_t":(0.95, 0.93, 0.97),      # target Vref -> sets R4
    "Lp":    (6.0, 2.0, 12.0),        # PMOS mirror L (line reg / PSRR)
    "gmid_p":(14.0, 10.0, 16.0),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 4.0),         # NMOS level-shift pair L
    "gmid_n":(20.0, 14.0, 24.0),
    "Cc":    (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 5e-12), # pg-to-vdd cap (stability / PSRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    mQ1 = 4
    mQ2 = mQ1 * N
    R1 = p["R1"]
    R3 = p["k3"] * R1
    dVbe = UT * math.log(N)
    Ip = dVbe / R1                                      # PTAT part per branch
    # estimate Veb at low current density (10 uA ref -> 0.76 V for m=1)
    Veb = 0.70
    for _ in range(5):
        Ic = Veb / R3
        Veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / (Ip / mQ1))
    Ic = Veb / R3
    I = Ip + Ic
    R4 = p["vref_t"] / I

    # devices
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.7)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.4, vsb=Veb)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PMOS mirror (pg = MP2 diode)
    n.dev("MP1", "na", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP2", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP3", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # NMOS level-shift pair forcing V(A) = V(B)
    n.dev("MN1", "na", "na", "ea", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MN2", "pg", "na", "eb", "vss", mn)
    # PNP core
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "ea", m=mQ1)
    n.R("R1", "eb", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=mQ2)
    # CTAT current resistors (Banba)
    n.R("R3A", "ea", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R3B", "eb", "vss", R3)
    # output
    n.R("R4", "vref", "vss", R4)
    n.C("CC", "pg", "vdd", p["Cc"])
    # start-up: inverter senses vref; when low, X high pulls pg low
    n.M("MS2", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("MS3", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.84, 1.0)
    n.M("MS1", "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.84, 0.5)

    # predictions
    dVeb_dT = (Veb - 1.17 - 3 * UT) / 300.0
    dI_dT = dVeb_dT / R3 + (dVbe / 300.0) / R1
    slope = dI_dT * R4                                  # V/K (first order, residual curvature added)
    vref = I * R4
    curv = 0.0035                                       # ~3.5 mV bow over -40..125 C
    tc = (abs(slope) * 165 + curv) / vref / 165 * 1e6
    gds_over_id = mp.gds / I
    line_reg = vref * (gds_over_id + gds_over_id / math.log(N))
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 20e-9)
    psrr = -db(line_reg / 1.0) if line_reg > 0 else 60
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
